title.zh: 真空里究竟有什么在传播

desc.zh: 信号穿过真空时没有空气也没有导线，到底是什么在传？十个可动模型：延迟场线、位移电流、一维 Yee FDTD 电磁波、偶极辐射、坡印廷能流与光压、偏振、全频谱与量子边界、大气窗口、链路预算、光纤相控阵与 2026 前沿。
desc.en: With neither air nor wires in empty space, what carries sunlight and radio across billions of kilometres? Ten interactive physics models from Maxwell's equations and 1-D Yee FDTD to link budgets, phased arrays and 2026 records.

title.zh: 场的因果延迟与 1/r 横向折痕
title.en: Causal Field Kinks and the 1/r Transverse Field

desc.zh: 改变电荷运动的消息以有限光速 c 向外传播，在波前壳层甩出按 1/r 缓慢衰减的横向辐射场。
desc.en: News of a charge's acceleration spreads at speed c, leaving a transverse field kink whose 1/r decay carries energy to infinity.

zh: 电磁波为什么能在真空传播
光在真空里靠什么传播
en: how does light travel through empty space
what carries radio waves in vacuum

title.zh: 位移电流与麦克斯韦方程组

desc.zh: 变化的电场 ε₀∂E/∂t 如同电流一样绕出磁场，与法拉第电磁感应咬合，使真空能自己闭环。
desc.en: A changing electric field acts as displacement current to induce a magnetic loop, closing the loop with Faraday's law in empty space.

zh: 电容器中间是真空为什么能通交流电
en: how AC crosses a vacuum capacitor

title.zh: 一维电磁波动方程、c=1/√(μ₀ε₀) 与 FDTD
title.en: The Wave Equation, c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀), and 1-D Yee FDTD

desc.zh: 耦合旋度方程直接推出横波与光速 c，在介质界面满足菲涅尔反射，并可用 Yee 蛙跳格点精确求解。
desc.en: Maxwell's curl equations yield a transverse wave at c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀), simulated directly on a Yee FDTD leapfrog grid.

zh: 光速为什么是30万公里每秒
折射率为什么减慢光速
en: speed of light from mu0 eps0

title.zh: 加速电荷辐射与半波偶极天线
title.en: Larmor Radiation and the Half-Wave Dipole

desc.zh: 只有加速电荷以 P ∝ a² 向垂直方向（sin²θ）辐射，半波偶极子恰好给出 73.1 Ω 辐射电阻。
desc.en: Only accelerating charges radiate (Larmor P ∝ a², sin²θ pattern), and a λ/2 dipole yields 73.1 Ω radiation resistance.

zh: 手机天线为什么不能太短

title.zh: 坡印廷能流、光压与三片偏振片
title.en: Poynting Flux, Radiation Pressure, and Polarisation

desc.zh: 电磁波搬运能量 S = E×B/μ₀ 与光压 I/c，其横向电场投影遵循马吕斯定律（三片偏振片 1/8 透射）。
desc.en: EM waves carry Poynting flux and radiation pressure I/c, while transverse polarisation obeys Malus's law including the three-polariser paradox.

zh: 三片偏振片为什么能透光

title.zh: 电磁频谱、经典-量子边界与非电离辐射
title.en: The EM Spectrum, Classical-to-Photon Boundary, and RF Safety

desc.zh: 室温 k_B T (6.25 THz) 与 ~10 eV 电离阈值划分经典加热与单光子断键；2.45 GHz 靠适中穿透深度热透食物，并非水分子共振。
desc.en: Thermal energy k_B T (6.25 THz) and ~10 eV ionisation separate classical waves from single-photon effects; 2.45 GHz heats food via penetration depth, not water resonance.

zh: 电离辐射和非电离辐射区别

title.zh: 地球大气窗口与电离层反射

desc.zh: 电离层反射短波、水汽与氧气在 22/60/183 GHz 关门，仅留射电、可见光与中红外窗口通向地面。
desc.en: Ionospheric reflection below ~10 MHz, O₂/H₂O lines and ozone UV absorption leave narrow radio, optical and IR windows to the ground.

zh: 为什么 X 射线望远镜要放太空
短波为什么能绕地球传播

title.zh: 载波调制与弗里斯链路预算
title.en: Modulation and the Friis Link Budget

desc.zh: 信号靠改变幅度/频率/相位携载比特，并以弗里斯公式在 Wi-Fi、GPS（低于噪声底 18 dB）和 173 AU 旅行者一号中兑现。
desc.en: AM, FM and QAM encode bits onto carriers, while the Friis link budget governs Wi-Fi, GPS below thermal noise, and Voyager 1 at 173 AU.

zh: 旅行者一号那么远怎么通信
GPS 信号为什么这么弱
en: why GPS signal is below noise

title.zh: 光纤全反射窗口、衍射极限与相控阵
title.en: Optical Fibre Windows, Diffraction Limit, and Phased Arrays

desc.zh: 光纤借全反射与 1550 nm 黄金谷底锁住光波；自由空间则依赖 1.22λ/D 口径与半波长间距内的相控阵干涉避免栅瓣。
desc.en: Silica fibres trap light via TIR at the 1550 nm loss minimum, while free-space beams obey 1.22λ/D and phased-array steering without grating lobes.

title.zh: 2026 年电磁前沿与三把检验尺子

desc.zh: 对照空芯光纤 0.091 dB/km、NICT 1.02 Pbps、DSOC 深空激光、Wi-Fi 7、手机直连、High-NA EUV 与太赫兹空白。
desc.en: Separating physics limits, 2025-2026 demonstrated records (hollow-core fibre, DSOC laser, High-NA EUV, D2C) and 6G/THz roadmaps.
